summary: This Part II supplies the proof-specific weight-four constructions behind the explicit Zagier theorem: specialized relations, cluster cells, motivic correlators, decorated flags, Grassmannian configurations, residues and a regulator comparison. Lower weights, the determinant statement and the general conjecture are imported from Polylogarithms and its K-theoretic suppliers. Explicit and inductive presentations remain distinct, and unresolved comparison and construction leaves are recorded rather than assumed.

nodes.title: One-parameter specialization
nodes.statement: For x=tᵃu, y=tᵇv with a,b integers and u,v regular units at t=0, put u₀=u(0), v₀=v(0). On U(F(t)), specialization sends x to u₀. On single symbols it sends Sₙ(x) to Sₙ(u₀) if a=0 and to 0 otherwise. On D₂₁ it gives D₂₁(u₀,v₀) if a=b=0; −S₃(v₀) if a>0,b=0; −S₃(u₀) if a=0,b>0; 2S₃(u₀/v₀) if a=b<0; and zero otherwise. On D₃₁ the corresponding five cases are D₃₁(u₀,v₀), S₄(v₀), −S₄(u₀), 3S₄(u₀/v₀), and zero. These are raw-symbol linear maps for the fixed parameter, not a claim of parameter independence in weight one.

Combinatorial constructions use an infinite field F. Motivic realizations and the final comparison use a number field F.
proofSteps: Decompose nonzero rational functions by order and leading unit.
Apply the displayed disjoint cases to the basis and extend linearly.

nodes.title: Oriented Stasheff cells
nodes.statement: K_m is the cellular associahedron for a labelled convex (m+3)-gon: a face is a noncrossing partial dissection and is a product of associahedra indexed by its regions. Its dimension is m minus the number of chosen diagonals. Choose an orientation on the top cell and induced boundary orientations, with the cellular incidence differential d and the Koszul product boundary. This is a finite combinatorial cellular complex, not a new topological moduli-space assumption.
hypotheses: All groups and complexes in this roadmap have rational coefficients; U(F)=F×⊗Z Q.
Combinatorial constructions use an infinite field F. Motivic realizations and the final comparison use a number field F.
proofSteps: Represent diagonals by unordered nonadjacent vertex pairs and enforce the noncrossing predicate.
Orient face products consistently and define signed incidence maps.
Opposite ways of adding two diagonals have opposite signs, proving d²=0.
acceptance: Cellular orientations must match the flip square in cluster-boundaries.

nodes.title: Cyclic words and special derivations
nodes.statement: Fix a finite rational puncture set S={a,s₁,…,s_n} and a tangent at a. Let V be the rational puncture-loop space generated by X_s, s∈S, with Σ_s X_s=0, using X_{s₁},…,X_{s_n} as a basis. Form C(V)=⊕_{r≥1}(V^⊗r)_{cyclic rotation}. First quotient by the pure-puncture cyclic words ⟨X_s,…,X_s⟩ for s≠a, and then by every first-shuffle sum Σ_{σ∈Sh(p,q)}⟨v₀,v_{σ(1)},…,v_{σ(p+q)}⟩ for p,q≥1. In positive correlator weights retain word length r≥2 and assign weight r−1, with the usual Tate regrading (1). Call this reduced object CLie_S. The pure-puncture reduction matters in length two (higher pure powers are already killed rationally by shuffle); it removes the central kernel of the derivation action. The cut cobracket is the sum of ⟨v_i,…,v_j⟩∧⟨v_j,…,v_{i−1}⟩ over the cyclic cuts of GR (66), keeping only positive-weight factors. It descends through cyclic and shuffle relations and satisfies co-Jacobi. Labels may repeat but equality of the cut labels is not required. The identification of its graded dual with special derivations is the separate comparison target below.

nodes.statement: Let ℓ≥3, a≠b, and x₁,…,x_ℓ be rational points different from a and b, with repetitions permitted. For I⊆{1,…,ℓ}, let x^I replace x_i by a exactly when i∈I. nodes.title: The generic-flag comparison on group homology
nodes.statement: Over an infinite field the augmented complex of generic decorated-flag tuples before taking GL_N coinvariants is acyclic: every finite cycle is coned off by a flag generic to its finite support. nodes.title: The normal-crossing coefficient diagram
nodes.statement: For a smooth complex variety X and a fixed finite simple-normal-crossing support D, form the finite coefficient diagram on the smooth strata Y of D needed by the Chern cocycle. A codimension-q stratum carries Γ-exp(k(Y),4−q), with weight-zero Q in internal degree zero; a term of internal degree j has total degree j+2q. Use the imported low-weight symbol differentials and uniformizer-first residues θ_v(π∧u₁∧…)=ū₁∧…, θ_v(all-unit wedge)=0; single Bloch symbols specialize to the residue class for valuation zero and to zero otherwise. Require every intermediate symbol and residue in the chosen finite diagram to have the specified SNC support. With these closure hypotheses the horizontal and signed residue arrows form a complex; the extra singular-stratum homotopy H of a general regular-variety construction is zero in this case. This target constructs only the coefficient diagram used below, not a Gersten resolution or a motivic quasi-isomorphism for all regular X.

nodes.title: The weight-four current regulator
nodes.statement: On the admissible normal-crossing diagram, the canonical period forms are locally integrable and define currents. For each codimension-q stratum take (2πi)^q times its pushed-forward period current. Together with the logarithmic holomorphic dlog component β on the exterior column these define a map r_D to the weight-four real Deligne cone. For a term of total degree k its ordinary current degree is k−1; the Deligne complex uses its corresponding shifted degree k. The current identity is dP−Pδ=2πiΣ_Y i_{Y*}P res_Y with the incidence signs fixed in normal-crossing-diagram. Nonproper simplicial BGL pieces require the logarithmic Deligne extension in request DELIGNE; the parent’s projective-only comparison is insufficient.

nodes.title: Weight-three scissors configurations
nodes.statement: A₃(F) is the rational scissors group of two ordered projective tetrahedra ⟨L;M⟩ in P³(F). nodes.statement: Compose flag-comparison, duality and the configuration map with the regularized motivic lift, and use correlator depth reduction to obtain an L₄-valued weight-four cocycle on the generic simplicial flag space for GL_N, N≥4.
